selected_registration.summary: 从方阵一角看可见格点，观察者所在原点不计；1≤N≤40000。坐标范围0..N−1，可见当且仅当两坐标互素。N=1输出0；其余用1+2倍phi[1..N−1]之和，注意phi(1)=1。先筛到N−1，再累加phi；时间、空间均O(N)，答案用long long。

scope: Actual phi-consumption application; not formal template verification. No OJ/CI/full-suite/LSan claim. Other prime/lp/mu APIs not independently verified.
